label: 2 — Interactive Code Generation (sranger, iter 1)
summary: Cold codegen of the SRanger controller from system_description.txt + requirement_all.json (24 requirements). 8 Java files; all requirements traced in result_codegen.json.

issues.title: Terminal mode renamed Final -> Halted
issues.detail: CLAUDE.md requires the theory-generated (primary) controller to contain no RoboChart Final state; SRanger is single-controller. Halted is an ordinary absorbing state entered on endTask, issuing Move(0,0) on entry.

issues.title: Halted tick self-loop (no action)
issues.detail: Added beyond SR-Beh1..7 so the terminal mode has a bare-precondition operation for the Isabelle deadlock-freedom proof. No source-mode/trigger duplication; SR-DC1 holds.

issues.title: Move(lv, av) realised as 2-arg Actuator.move call
issues.detail: Multi-arg actuator calls become RoboChart operation Calls (LOperations), preserving both payload values; a single-payload OutputEvent record would drop av in extraction.

issues.title: Initial Moving entry action issued from constructor
issues.detail: SR-FR1 power-up forward command fires in the constructor at the Java level; the model-level Initial -> Moving transition carries no action.

issues.title: Moving -> Turning carries both Obstacle trigger and obstacleDetected guard
issues.detail: SR-GP1 explicitly requires the predicate as the guard on this transition; SR-Beh2 supplies the trigger.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading default = 1000.0 m
issues.detail: Spec says 'a large default value'; 1000.0 chosen, well above obstacleThreshold 0.5.

issues.title: Turning -> Moving kept autonomous (guard-only)
issues.detail: SR-Beh5 says autonomous, no event required; placed below endTask (priority) and above the tick self-loop.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> ... -> vacuity) and act on per-phase feedback.
